scenario_description:
Objective: Add a free external eyepiece-cleaning slot to an already planned winter star party.
Emerging Need: A possible service table is initially uncertain, then becomes useful only when compatibility, intake channel, and a same-evening cutoff are confirmed.
Decision Context: Her equipment-care record is needed to identify a qualifying eyepiece and provide exact item details rather than guessing from broad booth notices.
Consequence: Timely coordination could improve views during future observing; ignoring it simply leaves the star party and kit unchanged once the queue locks.

parameter.title: Sonoran Nightwatchers Winter Star Party
parameter.description: Casual member observing night with possible sponsor tables near the Ramada before dark adaptation.
parameter.location: Tucson Mountain Park Ironwood Picnic Area

parameter.subject: Winter Star Party sponsor-table preview
parameter.body: Members attending the January winter star party may see a few optional sponsor tables before observing begins. Desert Precision Optics is trying to bring a no-cost external eyepiece-cleaning station, but the solvent shipment is not confirmed yet. Please do not send item requests until the intake note is posted; mirrors, camera sensors, and internal repairs will not be handled.

parameter.name: Desert Precision Optics Service Table
parameter.notes: Listed by Sonoran Nightwatchers for optional star-party eyepiece service communications.

parameter.content: Nightwatchers logistics update: Dana says the DPO solvent kit arrived, so the free cleaning table is real. They will preload only six eyepieces from emails received by 20:00 tonight. The email needs member name, eyepiece model, barrel size, and a note that it is external-glass cleaning only; no mirrors, camera sensors, or fungus cases.

parameter.subject: DPO eyepiece-cleaning queue locked
parameter.body: The six prepaid sponsor-table cleaning spots for the winter star party are now locked and have been sent to Desert Precision Optics. The table will not take additional walk-up items because the solvent tray is being portioned for the submitted queue only.
